description: The State Water Register is Russia's official register of water bodies, water management systems and water use rights, kept by the Federal Agency for Water Resources (Rosvodresursy). The register page on the agency site read on 2026-09-28 carries weekly notices titled "information on the provision of water bodies for use", dated from 23 July to 10 September 2026, alongside the normative documents and an archive; neighbouring sections cover the operating regimes of the largest reservoirs and their cascades, boundaries of flood and waterlogging zones, limits and quotas of water withdrawal, a register of unscrupulous water users and the agency's information systems. Coverage is national. Access is free to read; no licence is stated. Caveats: the page gives notices about water use grants, not the register database itself, which is served by a separate information system not read on the day, and reuse terms are unknown. It supports capacity planning studies of water withdrawals and reservoirs in Russia, as a pointer to official water use rights. No related Russian water register record is catalogued.
